title: Number sprint
tagline: Quick sums against the clock, with primes on the side.
teaser: Answer arithmetic problems as fast as you can, and play with factors, primes and numbers spelled out in words along the way.

manPage.synopsis: arithmetic — solve problems quickly; the more you get right, the faster it goes.
manPage.description: Built on four small BSD programs: Eamonn McManus’s arithmetic drill, Landon Curt Noll’s factor and primes, and number, which spells numerals out in English.

howToPlay: Solve each sum as quickly as you can.
The more you get right, the faster it goes.
Play with factors, primes and numbers in words on the side.
